name: AccordionCards
description: A row of numbered panels where the hovered or focused one expands, fills with the accent color, and reveals its title and description while the others narrow.
a11yNotes: Each panel is a native button with aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at its content; collapsed panels keep their title as visually hidden text. Focus expands a panel just like hover (or use expandOn="click"), and Arrow keys, Home and End move between panels. Reduced motion removes the width and fade transitions.

propsApi.name: descriptions
propsApi.description: One-line description per panel, shown when expanded.

propsApi.name: onIndexChange
propsApi.description: Called when the expanded panel changes.

propsApi.name: expandOn
propsApi.description: Expand on hover/focus, or only on click/Enter.

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Fill color of the expanded panel.

propsApi.name: activeTextColor
propsApi.description: Text color on the expanded panel.

propsApi.name: expandRatio
propsApi.description: How much wider the expanded panel grows.
